svg.title: Вращение плеча наружу на блоке — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. FIX ANCHOR SIDE ONLY. Preserve the man's working arm poses EXACTLY: in left panel fist near belly; in right panel fist outside the body on VIEWER'S LEFT, elbow fixed by that side of ribs. Move each entire cable tower from viewer's LEFT to viewer's RIGHT of that figure. Cable anchor must be on the OPPOSITE side of the body from the working elbow, at same elbow height. So the cable runs from the RIGHT tower ACROSS THE BELLY to the fist in BOTH panels. Delete the old left towers. Keep hollow white anatomical contour on black; no filled skin, no shading, no text. This represents external rotation against opposing cable tension. Do NOT change the elbow or arm movement. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
